name: elementalinference
description: This is the AWS Elemental Inference REST API Reference.

subcommands.name: associate-feed
subcommands.description: Associates a resource with the feed.

subcommands.name: create-dictionary
subcommands.description: Creates a custom dictionary for improving transcription accuracy.

subcommands.name: disassociate-feed
subcommands.description: Releases the resource (the source media) that is associated with this feed.

subcommands.name: export-dictionary-entries
subcommands.description: Exports the entries from the specified dictionary.

subcommands.name: get-dictionary
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the specified dictionary.

subcommands.name: get-feed
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the specified feed.

subcommands.name: list-dictionaries
subcommands.description: Lists the dictionaries in your account.

subcommands.name: list-feeds
subcommands.description: Displays a list of feeds that belong to this AWS account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: List all tags that are on an Elemental Inference resource in the current region.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Associates the specified tags to the resource identified by the specified resourceArn in the current region.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Deletes specified tags from the specified resource in the current region.

subcommands.name: update-feed
subcommands.description: Updates the name and/or outputs in a feed.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: feed-deleted
subcommands.description: Wait until a Feed is deleted It will poll every 3 seconds until a successful state has been reached.
